The main takeaway from our work is that
the BRST and co-BRST symmetries are not mere mathematical tools for quantization of gauge theories, but they also play an important role in the Hodge theory.
the BRST–anti-BRST formalism provides a natural and elegant framework to derive the co-BRST–(anti-)co-BRST symmetry in the present model.

the BRST formalism is not only a useful tool to construct consistent Lagrangians for a given gauge theory, but also it provides a natural setting to study the cohomology groups and their associated differential operators of Hodge theory in a simple and elegant way.
